title: Flowra v1.1.0 — Study Lock Distraction Blocker & UI Modernization

Added: Study Lock Distraction Blocker: Optional start-time distraction blocking for study/focus tasks with Accept & Reject prompts.
Real-Time App Blocker: Low-latency background detection using UsageStatsManager and AccessibilityService fallback.
Study Mode Active Overlay: Immersive full-screen focus shield showing live countdown, motivational quotes, attempt counter, and exit options.
Customizable Blocked Apps: Default distractions list plus searchable installed app picker.
Study Lock Dashboard: Dedicated bottom-nav tab with master switch, permission health check cards, and session history.
Celebration Animations: Particle confetti burst and haptic feedback on session completion.
Animated Status Badges: Fluid transitions for task progress indicators.
Changed: Upgraded SQLite database schema to version 3 with safe migration.
Bottom navigation footer expanded to 6 fixed tabs.
Modernized Material 3 dark/light theme accents and card elevations.
Fixed: Android 12–16 exact alarm permission handling with fallback to inexact scheduling.
Reboot and package update restoration for active study sessions.

Added: Study Timetable & Routine Planner: Daily/weekly interactive timelines, subject filtering, and overlap detection.
Exact Alarms & Offline Notifications: Survives phone restarts with high-priority Android alarm channels.
Study Focus & Pomodoro Mode: Clean focus timer with 25m, 45m, and 60m presets.
Daily Expense Tracker & Budget: Fast expense logging, category filtering, and 80%/100% budget alerts.
Visual Analytics & Reports: Weekly task completion charts and 30-day expense breakdowns.
100% Offline SQLite Storage with CSV export for all expense data.
Optional Developer Support screen with instant UPI deep-linking.
Automated CI/CD build pipeline for APK and AAB binaries.
Changed: Full brand refresh to Flowra with deep indigo Material 3 theme and new app icons.
Modular app footer and updated copyright info.
Fixed: Notification alarm triggers for Android 13/14+ exact alarm policies.
StudyFocusScreen layout overflow on smaller screen heights.
Resolved all analysis warnings and lints.
